sources.title: List of countries having reached unilateral and bilateral visa exemption agreement with Laos
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The current table is published directly from the Lao Ministry of Foreign Affairs mofa.gov.la domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The table identifies countries with unilateral and bilateral visa-exemption agreements and distinguishes ordinary-passport entries.

sources.title: Lao eVisa live country-price selector API
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official Lao eVisa site identifies its service as Ministry of Foreign Affairs-owned; its live client requests this mxf.laoevisa.gov.la selector endpoint.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The live endpoint returns 162 country records with stay_day, is_except, citizens, and watchlist fields.

sources.title: Lao Official Online Visa information
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The service is hosted on the official laoevisa.gov.la site, which its terms identify as Ministry of Foreign Affairs-owned and operated. On re-review its advertised public country-list link returned 404, so this page is not used to infer eligibility from omission; the live selector API remains the positive eligibility evidence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Lao eVisa facility is available for listed countries and is usable only at designated ports.

sources.title: Lao Official Online Visa terms and conditions
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Lao PDR
sources.officialityEvidence: The terms expressly state that laoevisa.gov.la is owned, operated, and made by the Lao Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Only ordinary passports are applicable; Tourist Visa T-B3 permits 30 days after arrival.

sources.title: Decree on penalties and other measures for entry, exit and foreigner management
sources.officialityEvidence: The decree bears the Lao PDR government emblem and is served from the official immigration.gov.la API domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa on arrival refers to countries in a Ministry of Foreign Affairs notice; watch-listed nationals cannot apply.

sources.title: Laos international border checkpoints
sources.officialityEvidence: The official immigration.gov.la service identifies the Department of Immigration of Lao PDR and its official contact details. Its checkpoint route is client-rendered and supplies port-service labels, but no nationality entitlement or exhaustive VOA schedule was available from it on re-review.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Checkpoint descriptions label available services as Visa on Arrival and eVisa.

unresolved.reason: The reviewed immigration decree regulates passports and penalties for Lao citizens as well as foreigners, but does not directly establish a Lao citizen's ordinary-passport entry/right-of-return status or visa treatment. No citizenship normalization is inferred.
